item.name: ember-badge
item.summary: feedback: Unread-count badge that is a live ember: flares on new items, cools to ash at zero (canvas 2D, server-safe, reduced motion -> static badge)

useWhen: An unread or pending count on an icon button, avatar or tab
A notification bell in a header where new items deserve a moment of attention
avoidWhen: Many badges in one list (one ember per screen is enough)
Counts that change several times a second (it would flare constantly)

tiers.0: The control alone (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: A static ember-coloured badge with the number; no flare, no sparks, no canvas.

input.pointer: None of its own: the wrapped element keeps its own handlers
input.keyboard: None of its own: the wrapped button or link stays focusable

a11y.notes: The visible number is aria-hidden; a visually hidden role=status reads "<count> <label>" when the count changes. The wrapped element keeps its own name and role.

props.name: count
props.effect: Required. The unread count; a rise flares the ember, 0 cools it to ash and hides the number.

props.name: children
props.effect: Required. The element the badge sits on (an icon button, an avatar).

props.name: max
props.effect: Counts above this show as max+.

props.name: label
props.effect: What the count counts, read after the number by screen readers.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: Put the accessible name on the wrapped button (aria-label="Inbox"); the badge only adds the count.
The sparks rise above the badge: do not clip the parent with overflow: hidden.
Pass the real count (a number), not a string; the badge formats max+ itself.
verify: Server HTML shows the number on a static ember badge.
Raising count flares the ember and a status message reads the new count.
At count 0 the number disappears and the loop stops.
